title: Грозовой берег
palette: Navy and storm grey, nearly black basalt, blue-green inlet water, weathered brown wood and rusty red nautical accents. No warm ivory garden.
terrain: A low long jagged coastline slab with a diagonal sheltered inlet cutting deeply into the interior, uneven black basalt headlands connected by broad inland land corridors.
landmarks: A short off-center rust-red semaphore mast with thick paddles, low timber rain shelter, sheltered inlet and heavy basalt arch. One small pond with rain ripple relief; no airborne rain streaks or mist hiding geometry.
road: Wide rough slate coastal road changing to thick brown timber decking near the shelter, grey gravel shoulders.
journey: Turn inland between basalt headlands, skirt the deep inlet on alternating broad curves, pass through the heavy arch, cross an exposed grassy interior and arrive beside the shelter. Then follow the NEW guide return corridor back into the beginning smoothly and continue the same winding circuit as many times as needed.
style: Bold nautical silhouettes, simplified weathered basalt and damp material sheen, cool overcast material lighting.
architecture: Two low weatherproof radio homes embedded in NORTHWEST basalt headland; NORTHEAST shelter deck becomes a timber/navy-steel radio depot with chunky roof antenna and heavy brass exhaust. One squat rust-red signal/windmill tower on SOUTHEAST rock buttress, thick paddle arms instead of a fine lattice mast. Damp timber, navy roofs and rusty brass.
